STATUS: fail

SUMMARY: Three Dialog and Tabs behaviours fail under reproduction: nested dialogs both close on one Escape, focus returns to body after a child `autoFocus`, and Tab can leave the dialog from a `tabindex=-1` element. Tabs also renders no selected tab in server-rendered HTML. Combobox, the Tabs controlled/keyboard paths and the rest of the Dialog probes held. Probe files are deleted and `git status` matches the start.

FILES TOUCHED: none (probes `src/__probe__.test.tsx` and `src/__probe2__.test.tsx` were created and deleted)

FINDINGS:
- [blocking] Nested dialogs: one Escape closes both. Both Dialogs listen for Escape on `document`. `P1`: `expected "spy" to be called +0 times, but got 1 times` (outer `onOpenChange` fired). Also seen in `Q3`, where the outer dialog unmounts on the inner Escape.
- [blocking] `autoFocus` child breaks focus return (D5). The opener is read with `document.activeElement` in the effect, after the child's autoFocus has already moved focus into the dialog. `Q2`: open from button, Escape, `expected <body><button></button>` to have focus; focus lands on body. `Q2b`: unmount while open with an autoFocus input restores to body, not the opener.
- [blocking] Focus escapes the dialog via `tabindex=-1` content (D3/D6). `trapTab` only wraps when the active element is first or last in the focusable list. `P8`/`Q1`: dialog with a button and `<span tabIndex={-1}>`, focus on the span, Tab → `activeElement` is `body`, not inside the dialog.
- [blocking, SSR scope] `renderToString` of `Tabs defaultValue="c"` produces no `aria-selected="true"` on any tab, because the selection is computed in a layout effect. `P11`: `expected '<div>…' to match /aria-selected="true"/`. Fix or state the client-only limitation in the README.
- [minor] README line 66–67 says a `visibility: visible` child under a hidden parent is focusable. The code matches, but the "Visibility is inherited, so…" wording reads as a contradiction. Reworded sentence suggested.
- [minor] Combobox cannot clear the selection from the UI (`null` is never emitted). The README documents this and parent-driven `value={null}` works, but it's worth confirming this is intended.
- [minor] `FEATURE_FLOW.md` is in FILES but does not exist, and the diff does not touch it.
- [minor] Dialog backdrop has no styling, so in a real browser it is zero-sized and the backdrop-click close is effectively unreachable without consumer CSS. Not reproduced in jsdom.

CHECKS:
- `P2` Combobox in Dialog: Escape with listbox open closes only the listbox → pass
- `P3` Combobox in form: Enter with open listbox does not submit; Enter after close does → pass
- `P4` two Tabs with identical values get distinct tab and panel ids → pass
- `P5` 11 special-char values (spaces, `_32_`, `é`, quotes, `:`, `/`, empty): ids unique, aria-controls and aria-labelledby resolve → pass
- `P6`/`P6b` focus skips focusables in `display:none`, `hidden` and `visibility:hidden` subtrees → pass
- `P7` open→close→open ×3 returns focus to the opener each time → pass
- `P9` drag from inside to backdrop does not close; `P9b` real backdrop click closes → pass
- `P10` dialog mounted open, then unmounted, restores focus (no autoFocus child) → pass
- `P12`/`P13`/`P13b` selected tab disabled or removed (uncontrolled and controlled): one selected, one tabbable → pass
- `P14` arrows skip disabled, wrap, End → pass
- `P15` uncontrolled click: no call on re-select, call on new tab → pass
- `P16` prepend while open keeps active on Banana; Enter commits "b" → pass
- `P16b` active removed by options change: no aria-activedescendant, Enter no-op → pass
- `P17` `(`, `.*`, whitespace, empty label, no-results message → pass
- `P18` controlled parent ignores onChange; blur restores parent's label → pass
- `P19` clicking a disabled option does nothing → pass
- `P20` Escape restores the selected label → pass
- `Q4` controlled Tabs ignoring onValueChange: arrows move focus, aria-selected unchanged → pass
- `Q5` clearing text and Enter/blur never call onChange → pass
- `Q6` single option: ArrowDown wraps, Enter chooses → pass
- `Q7` all filtered options disabled: no active, Enter no-op → pass
- `pnpm vitest run` probes: 24 + 8 cases, 6 failures reproduced (above)
- Not run: `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` (orchestrator already ran the suite)

OPEN QUESTIONS:
- Is SSR in scope? If not, the SSR finding becomes a README note.
- Should Combobox support clearing to null in the UI? The README says no.
- Does FEATURE_FLOW.md exist in another branch, or should it be dropped from the checklist?
